title: Vintage California Brochure Lot Muir Woods Santa Barbara Doheny Library 1970s
condition_description: Muir Woods clean, no writing. Santa Barbara (June 1978) and Doheny (Nov. 3, 1974) brochures have handwritten dates on the covers; Doheny has a crease across the cover photo and a small corner chip. Normal fold lines throughout.
description:
Lot of 3 vintage California visitor brochures:

1) Vintage Muir Woods National Monument, California visitor brochure and trail map from the National Park Service, U.S. Department of the Interior.

- GPO 1974-543-530/84, Reprint 1974; map revised Dec 1973
- Fold-out trail map of Redwood Canyon: Bootjack, Ben Johnson, Dipsea, Hillside and Fern Creek trails, Cathedral Grove, Bohemian Grove, Kent and Pinchot memorials, visitor center
- Inset map of Mt. Tamalpais State Park, Stinson Beach and Muir Beach
- Text on the redwoods, plants, animal life, the park's naming for John Muir, and "We're Joining the Metric World" with a kilometers-to-miles chart

Condition: clean, with normal fold lines and no writing (see photos).

2) Vintage Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History fold-out brochure, 2559 Puesta del Sol Road, Santa Barbara, California.

- Sepia photo cover "inside... the gates..." with the museum's tile-roof entrance and twisted columns
- "Guide to the Museum" floor plan: Bird Habitat Hall, Mammal Hall, Marine Hall, Insect Hall, Mineral Hall, California Indian Hall, Paleontology and Geology Hall, Planetarium, Education Center and more
- Panels on education, research, exhibits and membership, with 1970s annual membership rates and museum hours - "Admission Always Free"

Condition: used. Someone wrote a date (June 1978) on the cover. Normal fold lines and light wear (see photos).

3) The Estelle Doheny Collection of the Edward Laurence Doheny Memorial Library, St. John's Seminary, Camarillo, California - tri-fold visitor brochure. Handwritten date on the cover: Nov. 3, 1974.

- History of the library (designed by Wallace Neff, dedicated 1940) and its treasures: the Gutenberg Bible Old Testament volume, 7,000 rare books, Currier & Ives prints, Remington and Charles Russell art, the paperweight collection
- Directions map to the seminary off the Ventura Freeway

Condition: fold lines, light wear, a crease across the cover photo and a small chip at one corner (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
